chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Sayf ibn 'Amirah, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever is wise (has intellect/reason), he has a religion (faith/piety), and whoever has a religion, he will enter Paradise.'
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between wisdom and entering Paradise in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Thawab al-A'mal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a causal chain where intellectual discernment ('aql) fosters religious commitment (din), which ultimately guarantees entry into Paradise. This reflects the Shia epistemological view that 'aql is not merely rationality but the faculty that recognizes divine truth, making it the foundation of 'iman. The narration underscores the inseparable link between cognitive clarity and spiritual salvation in Twelver Shi'ism.
